name: Super Mario Odyssey companion
_about: Native maps for 17 kingdoms/22 variants; live player, objective, health, coin wallet, deposited total and unbanked moon row; Tasks/Stats; native checkpoint travel and reversible HUD visibility. English; all 61 task rules verified. Android/NCE boots and loads the package; an Android save-account mismatch affecting save-backed Tasks/Stats progress is fixed by the Eden Duo 1.3.2.2 host runtime.
_font: font_metrics_src is a tiny marker file ('smo-font 1'), not game data: PACKAGE_FORMAT.md section 3.1 allows exactly one font/font_atlas pair per manifest, but the accepted design needs six native BFFNT roles at once (MessageFont38 body, TitleFont60 headers, HeadFont72 hero digits, NumberFont26 HUD counters, PictureFont80 + IconFont80 pictograms). The module's decode_font extension (smo_font.{h,cpp}) recognises this marker, fetches the six real .bffnt members itself via host->read_romfs (base:/LocalizedData/USen/LayoutData/FontData.szs#<Name>.bffnt -- always base:, never romfs:, since the 1.4.1 update's FontData.szs is a truncated Yaz0 stream for every language), and reports one merged glyph table covering all six. A `file:` marker (not a `.bffnt` path) is required so RequestNxFont()'s own 'is this a .bffnt?' heuristic (mod_nx_runtime.cpp) never intercepts the read and tries the host's built-in single-font BFFNT parser before this module's decode_font gets a chance.
_font_atlas: font_atlas must be set explicitly (ModRuntime::LoadFont() bails out silently if it is empty, before ever reaching the asset worker). It is a paged module: key (font_page_h, runtime 17): the module's load_image extension slices its merged RGBA atlas into kAtlasPageRows=1024-row pages on request (smo_font.h AtlasPage()), so no single page ever risks the host's 4096x4096/16MiB load_image cap even though the full atlas is several thousand rows tall (6 fonts x up to ~95 glyphs each).
_font_roles: Codepoint plan (documented in full in smo_font.h): Body/unshifted U+0020..U+007E is MessageFont38, EXCEPT '0'-'9' '/' ',' '.' '-' ':' which come from NumberFont26 even unshifted -- the host's 'value' widget always draws literal ASCII digit codepoints and there is no manifest key to redirect it to a different font role, so this is the only way every HUD counter (this page's coin value below, and any future one) renders in the native NumberFont26, as the accepted design requires. Title/Head/Number/Picture/Icon each additionally get their own PUA block (U+E000/E100/E200/E300/E400 + native codepoint) for label text that explicitly asks for that role (plain JSON \uE0xx escapes below -- see smo_font.h's Styled() for how a module would build the same string at runtime). HeadFont72 is unused on this page (it lacks b/j/q/v/w/z; the header/banner role is TitleFont60, not HeadFont72).
_value_widget_centering: DrawValue has no vertical centering on the pinned runtime. Baseline is rect.y + text_scale*5; ratio is text_scale*5 / line_height. NumberFont26 has baseline 25 and cell_h 30; at scale 15 against merged line_height 46, centering its glyph cell inside a 64px slab gives rect.y = slab_y - 26.70, rounded to 95/169 for slab_y 122/196. Placeholder labels use the same y without text_center_h. max_bind/max_sep cannot be combined with pad on this runtime; the regional slab currently shows 0/100.
_font_line_height: Merged atlas line_height 46 matches the native TitleFont60 cap-height probe. Header title scale 9 gives about 45 px capitals; neighbouring pages scale 7 gives about 35 px. The title is lifted 11 px so descenders clear the page dots at y=88.
